description: This file declares the LocalStore class, which implements the ILocalStore interface to manage local data storage using an SQLite database. The class provides methods for opening databases, creating tables, setting entry limits, querying entry counts, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding new entries.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local data storage via SQLite, implementing the ILocalStore interface with methods for database operations.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a connection to the database at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting at a specified index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.
